set.body: Add the dependency-free graph crossProject with VertexIx, VertexBasis[K,V], key-order/set/metadata compatibility, validated permutations and induced-basis mappings, canonical loopless simple directed/undirected graphs, endpoint-derived edge identity, structural equality independent of input edge order, and shared JVM/JS law tests.
set.title: Graph core: ordered bases, alignment, and canonical simple graph values
